items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 14 at 1:34PM CST until November 16 at 3:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Chambers; Inland Jackson; Inland Matagorda; Inland Brazoria; Inland Galveston; Coastal Harris; Coastal Jackson; Coastal Matagorda; Coastal Brazoria; Coastal Galveston
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 mph with gusts up to 35 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Jackson, Inland Jackson, Chambers, Coastal
Brazoria, Coastal Galveston, Coastal Harris, Coastal Matagorda,
Inland Brazoria, Inland Galveston, and Inland Matagorda Counties.

* WHEN...From 9 AM Sunday to 3 PM CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...East winds will become northeast behind a cold
front late Sunday.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Gale Watch issued November 14 at 1:12PM CST until November 16 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Matagorda Bay; Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20 NM; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM; Waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX from 20 to 60 NM; Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, southeast winds 20 to 25
kt with gusts up to 30 kt and Gulf seas 6 to 9 ft expected. For
the Gale Watch, northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40
kt and Gulf seas 8 to 13 ft possible.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 6 PM CST Sunday.
For the Gale Watch, from Sunday evening through Monday
afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
